resources.string: Fetch and fast-forward every added local repository. Pull All never stages, commits or pushes your changes.

For quick access, add the Pull All home-screen widget or add the GitSync.md Pull All tile when editing Quick Settings. Both run once without opening the app. Open Pull All afterward to review the saved summary; choose Pull All Again for another run.
Stopped. A repository already being pulled may have finished. Check its Git status before retrying; remaining repositories were not started.
Pull All could not start. Check repository settings and retry.
No local repositories to pull. Clone or import a repository first.
Pull completed; some LFS contents need download. Open Git LFS to retry.
Kept unchanged. Commit or stash local changes, finish the active Git operation, or configure an upstream branch before retrying.
Could not pull safely. Check connection and storage access, then inspect Git controls for divergence or other recovery needs.
Fetch and fast-forward all local repositories without opening GitSync.md.
